limits: A bootstrap cannot produce a day worse than the worst day observed. This arm's history is calm-regime -- the go-live gate discloses zero days with VIX>20 and zero days down more than 1% -- so these tails are LOWER BOUNDS on a stressed month, not forecasts of one.
Days are resampled i.i.d., discarding autocorrelation. If bad days cluster, real drawdowns are deeper than modelled.
The -$400 cap is applied as a floor on each resampled day, which is the cap's intent rather than a tick-level simulation of it.
